enrichment.headline: Expands T-Mobile student hot spot program to 10,000 lines through 2026, up to $2.33M total
enrichment.summary: This amends the district's Project 10Million agreement with T-Mobile to add student hot spots and cellular service, for a combined total of 10,000 lines. The new terms run from September 23, 2021 to June 30, 2026, with a cap of $2,334,000 overall and $466,800 per year. The text gives only the overall cap, not the amount added by this amendment. It is paid from grant and E-Rate (federal school internet discount) funding.

enrichment.headline: Pays Everlast up to $9,200 for vegetation fire clearing at Thurgood Marshall Elementary School
enrichment.summary: The district is hiring Everlast Development Inc. of Oakland to cut and haul away dry vegetation, clear weeds, and trim bushes, ivy and low branches along the fence line and around the grounds at Thurgood Marshall Elementary School, to meet the Oakland Fire Code. The price is $9,200, including a $3,000 contingency. Everlast was the lowest responsive bidder in a competitive bid, and work was scheduled to start July 26, 2021, before this approval, and end August 31, 2021.
